bigfoot_story.last_result: You gaze in a sense of vicarious awe, feeling deeply happy that the bigfoots have a place so befitting of their magnificence. Knowing that you do not belong in their home, you smile that you made the journey anyway, and begin to head home with your group. You have received $15,000 from a bigfoot accountant, as well as a new game background.

alien_story.last_result: You take no time to think, and with all eyes on you, including Mr. Goobles’ sad little saucer eyes, you summon your psychic powers. Lightning flies from your fingertips and cooks Mr. Goobles like a microwavable waffle. The story is swept under the rug by the Alien Security Service. Three-hundred years later, it surfaces, and your grave is routinely vandalized by the many teenagers who now sport Mr. Goobles tattoos.
